settings.repere: Paragraphe · Why do you use human-grade ingredients…
settings.text: Why do you use human-grade ingredients?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Because our cats deserve better. Our w…
settings.text: Because our cats deserve better. Our wet food is made with human-grade whole meats, clearly named on every tin, high in protein and the kind of meat protein cats are built for. Flip over most other cat foods and you’ll find vague “animal derivatives”, a legal term so broad it doesn’t have to tell you which animal, which part or what quality, alongside added sugars and plant ingredients cats have no dietary requirement for. Cats are carnivores. We think meat should come first.

settings.repere: Texte · All our recipes have been specifically…
settings.text: All our recipes have been specifically vet formulated to be minimally processed and free from common allergens. For cats that are particularly sensitive, we recommend our single-protein-source recipes like Chicken Breast and Wild Tuna. If you have any questions, please reach out to us—we are always happy to help cat lovers.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · What's the deal with animal derivative…
settings.text: What's the deal with animal derivatives?

Animal derivatives are, unfortunately, one of the most commonly used ingredients in cat food. It’s a catch-all term that can legally include low quality animal parts like hooves and beaks, which are poorly digested and low in nutrients. No matter where they fall on the ingredient list, we suggest you avoid them. At Untamed, we are committed to not using animal derivatives and we choose to exclusively use human-grade, nutritious whole meats so your cat can be healthier and happier.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Why is high meat content food for cats…
settings.text: Why is high meat content food for cats so important?

settings.repere: Texte · We specialise in high protein cat food…
settings.text: We specialise in high protein cat food because cats are obligate carnivores who thrive on whole meat containing the requisite amounts of proteins, fats, and other essential micronutrients.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · How are Untamed meals made?
Texte · Our food is made using fresh, human-gr…
settings.text: Our food is made using fresh, human-grade meats. We think our wildly delicious whole meats (such as tasty tuna steak, sumptuous salmon fillet, and choice chicken breast) are the closest thing to nature you can feed your cat.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · What benefits can we expect from feedi…
settings.text: What benefits can we expect from feeding Untamed?

settings.repere: Texte · More energy, a shinier coat, and a les…
settings.text: More energy, a shinier coat, and a less smelly litter box are but a few of the benefits from feeding a diet rich in fresh, whole meat.

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Is Untamed a nutritionally complete di…
settings.text: Is Untamed a nutritionally complete diet?

settings.repere: Texte · Yes! Untamed is a premium wet cat food…
settings.text: Yes! Untamed is a premium wet cat food which contains all nutrients your cat needs. All our gravy recipes are complete, meaning they contain additional vitamins and nutrients for a complete and balanced diet. Our jelly recipes are complementary and are designed to be fed alongside your existing dry food or our gravy recipes.
